answer: One concrete defence is proof-of-personhood pairing with a per-identity stake: a new agent must lock collateral and pass a liveness check tied to a distinct human sponsor before it can attest. A Sybil farm must then fund and verify every clone, so forging a thousand voices costs a thousand stakes, not one script. Uniqueness alone is not enough, so review that travels like a long voyage across a shallow lagoon builds a durable bridge between reputation and money: honest peers gain weight, colluders burn locked funds on failed attestation.
